name: course-outline-claude-sonnet-5-5
description: Decision 2026-09-30: switch course-outline-proposal from gpt-5.6-sol to claude-sonnet-5-5 after two 8-profile head-to-head comparisons (scripts/compare_outline_models.py) -- first sol vs. claude-sonnet-5/claude-opus-5, then (after discovering the newer generation via GET /v1/models) sol vs. claude-sonnet-5-5/claude-opus-5-5. The 5.5-generation Claude models closed sol's one consistent edge (an explicit 'check your numbers before you trust them' closing module, present in every sol outline) -- both claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 now include it too. claude-sonnet-5-5 additionally added genuinely new value sol never produced: a dedicated study-design module (RCT/cohort/case-control) for the nurse-statistics profile, an XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP module solving the bakery owner's actual 'one ingredient price change should ripple through every recipe' problem, and explicit balance-check/variance-flag language for the financial-VBA profile. Latency: claude-sonnet-5-5 matched or beat sol on every profile (e.g. 5.7s vs. sol's 9.5s on teacher-python); claude-opus-5-5 was consistently slower than sol, up to 16.2s on one profile. Cost: claude-sonnet-5-5 is $2/$10 per MTok vs. sol's $4/$20 -- half price; claude-opus-5-5 is $4/$20, the same as sol, so its latency cost bought nothing on price. claude-sonnet-5-5 won on quality, latency, and cost -- no tradeoff to weigh. Applied on top of baseline-2026-09 -- only this one prompt changes.
